advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Sefa masiku ya makhadi hi @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt kumbe @listEnteredAt. Xikombiso: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' kumbe @endAt = none. Veka vito ra ndhawu leyi endleriweke wena leri sungulaka hi @ endzeni ka swirhatana.
advanced-filter-description: Filitara ya le Henhla yi pfumelela ku tsala marito lama nga na swiendli leswi landzelaka: == != <= >= && || ( ) Xivandla xo pfumala nchumu xi tirhisiwa ku hambanisa swiendli. U nga hlunga Swivandla hinkwaswo swa ku Tiendlela hi ku tsala mavito na mimpimo ya swona. Xikombiso: Field1 == Value1. Xitsundzuxo: Loko swivandla kumbe mimpimo swi ri na swivandla swo pfumala nchumu, u fanele ku swi rhendzela hi tinhlamulo to ka tin'we. Xikombiso: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ku tlula swikombiso swa ku lawula swa xin'we (' \/), u nga tirhisa \. Xikombiso: Field1 == I\'m. Nakambe u nga hlanganisa swipimelo swo tala. Xikombiso: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Hi ntolovelo swiendli hinkwaswo swi hlayiwa ku suka eximatsini ku ya exinene. U nga cinca ku landzelelana hi ku veka swirhendzeleki. Xikombiso: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Nakambe u nga lavisisa swivandla swa matsalwa hi regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Yi fambisana loko khadi ri endliwa, kumbe nhloko-mhaka kumbe nhlamuselo ya rona yi cinciwa, naswona rungula lerintshwa ri ri na leswi (a ku na ku hambana ka maletere lamakulu na lamatsongo).

imported-member-no-account: Xirho lexi nghenisiweke — a ku si va na akhawunti leyi fambelanaka
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Namarheta JSON ya ku humesa ka Kanboard: nchumu lowu nga na "columns" (kumbe tasks leti nga na column_name) na nxaxamelo wa "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Tikholomu ti hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-deck: Namarheta JSON ya bodo ya NextCloud Deck (bodo leyi nga na "stacks", stack yin'wana na yin'wana yi ri na "cards" ta yona). Ti-stack ti hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona tikhadi ti hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Namarheta JSON ya nhlengeleto wa work-packages wa OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Swiyimo swi hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona ti-work package ti hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-issues: Namarheta nxaxamelo wa JSON wa swiphiqo swa __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Swiphiqo swi hundzuka tikhadi leti hlengeletiweke eka minxaxamelo ya Open / Closed.
import-board-instruction-asana: Namarheta JSON ya ku humesa ka mintirho ya Asana ({ "data": [...] } ku suka eka ku humesa ka Asana kumbe GET /tasks). Mintirho yi hlengeletiwa hi swiyenge (memberships); mintirho leyi heleleke yi ya eka Done.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Namarheta JSON ya ku humesa ka nxaxamelo wa ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Ti-stage ti hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona ti-item ti hundzuka tikhadi.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Namathisela nkarhi wa mintirho ya markdown (ndlela leyi swiendlakalo swa markdown-kanban swo fana na Obsidian Kanban swi yi tirhisaka): tinhloko ta "## Vito ra nkarhi", ni swilo swa "- [ ]"/"- [x]" ehansi. Tinhloko ti va tinxaxamelo naswona swilo swi va makhadi.
import-board-instruction-leo: Namarheta xivumbeko xa Leo (fayili ya .leo). Swiphemu swa xiyimo xa le henhla swi hundzuka minxaxamelo, swiphemu leswi nga ehansi ka swona hi ku kongoma swi hundzuka makhadi, naswona tsalwa ra xiphemu ri va nhlamuselo ya khadi. Swiphemu swa swiyimo leswi dzikeke swi hundzuka minxaxamelo yo kambela. Swiphemu leswi funghiweke swi nghenisiwa swi ri leswi hetiweke.
import-board-instruction-opml: Namarhela OPML outline, hilaha Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq na ti-outliner tin'wana ti yi humesaka hakona. Swilo swa le henhla swi va minxaxamelo, vana va swona va va makhadi lama nga ni nhlamuselo ya xitsundzuxo, naswona swilo swa le hansi swi va minxaxamelo yo kambela. Swilo leswi hetiweke swi nghenisiwa swi ri swi hetisiwile.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Namarhela fayili ya Org mode, hilaha Emacs, Orgzly kumbe Beorg swi yi tsalaka hakona. Tinhloko ta le henhla ti va minxaxamelo naswona tinhloko ta xiyimo xa vumbirhi ti va makhadi. TODO na DONE, nkoka, swikombiso, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE na CLOSED swa hlayisiwa, naswona swibokisana swo funghela na tinhloko ta le hansi swi va minxaxamelo yo kambela.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Namarheta fayili ya todo.txt: ntirho wun'we eka layini yin'wana ni yin'wana, hi ndlela leyi xitirhisiwa xa todo.txt ni switirhisiwa leswi fambelanaka na xona swi tsalaka ha yona. Mintirho leyi hetiweke ("x") yi ya eka leyi hetiweke, +project na @context swi hundzuka malebulu, (A) yi hundzuka lebulu ya ku rhangisa, kasi due: na t: swi hundzuka masiku ya makumu ni ya ku sungula.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Namarheta vuyelo bya task export: nxaxamelo wa JSON kumbe ntiro wun’we eka layini yin’wana ni yin’wana. Mintirho leyi hetiweke yi ya eka Done, project na priority swi hundzuka swikombiso, annotations yi hundzuka mavonelo, kasi depends yi hundzuka ku titshega hi mintirho leyi sivelaka.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Humesa fayili ya .boardarchive eka vuhlayiselo byo tshikileriwa kutani u namarheta leswi nga eka board.jsonl ya bodo, ni layini ya vuhundzuluxeri kumbe handle ka yona. Xihlawulekisi xo hlanganisa hi mintlawa eka xivono xa bodo xi hundzuka minxaxamelo, swihlawulekisi swin’wana swo hlawula swi hundzuka swikombiso, swiphemu swa tsalwa ni mabokisi yo fungha swi hundzuka nhlamuselo ni nxaxamelo wo kambela, naswona mavonelo ma hlayisiwa. Swifaniso ni swiengetelo a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: Eka MeisterTask, tlilika vito ra phurojeke, hlawula Export project u humesa CSV, kutani u yi namarhela. Swiyenge swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa swa yona, siku ro hetelela, muaveriwa na swikombiso; mintirho leyi hetiweke yi hlayisa siku ra yona ro hetisa. CSV leyi tsariweke ku nghenisiwa ka MeisterTask na yona ya tirha.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: Eka Obsidian, pfula fayili ya bodo ya Kanban tanihi Markdown (kumbe u pfula fayili ya .md eka xilulamisi xa matsalwa), kutani u namarhela hinkwayo. Tindlela ti va minxaxamelo na mpimo wa makhadi ya tona, makhadi ma hlayisa swikombiso swa wona, masiku, nkoka, swivandla na nxaxamelo wo kambela, naswona Archive yi va makhadi lama nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-linear: Eka Linear, humesa swiphiqo tanihi CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, kumbe ku humesa ka langutelo), kutani u namarhela CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, mintlawa yi va tindlela, naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi swin'we na muaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, xiphiqo xa mutswari, nkoka, xilinganiso, phurojeke na xirhendzevutani.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: Eka TickTick, pfula Settings, Account, Backup & Import u endla vuhlayiselo bya nseketelo, kutani u namarhela fayili ya CSV. Nxaxamelo wun'wana na wun'wana wa TickTick wu va ndlela naswona tikhalomu ta wona ti va minxaxamelo; mintirho yi hlayisa swikombiso swa yona, masiku, nxaxamelo wo kambela, nkoka na swintirhwana.
import-board-instruction-clickup: Eka ClickUp, humesa mintirho tanihi CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, kumbe ku humesa ka langutelo ra List kumbe Table na tikhalomu hinkwato), kutani u namarhela CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, minxaxamelo ya ClickUp yi va tindlela, naswona mintirho yi va makhadi swin'we na swintirhwana, vaaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, nkoka na nkarhi.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: Eka Nullboard, pfula bodo, hlawula Export this board... eka menyu, pfula fayili ya .nbx eka xilulamisi xa matsalwa u namarhela leswi nga eka yona. Minxaxamelo yi va minxaxamelo naswona swilo swo tsundzuxa swi va makhadi: layini yo sungula ya xitsundzuxo i nhloko-mhaka ya khadi naswona leswi saleke i nhlamuselo ya rona. Xitsundzuxo xa raw xi kuma xikombiso raw. Fayili leyi nga ni tibodo to tala yi nghenisa bodo ya yona yo sungula.
import-board-instruction-kanri: Eka Kanri, pfula Import & Export u hlawula Export individual board (kumbe Export all data), kutani u namarhela fayili ya .json. Tikhalomu ti va minxaxamelo naswona makhadi ma va makhadi, swin'we na nhlamuselo, siku ro hetelela, swikombiso na mihlovo ya wona; mintirho ya khadi yi va nxaxamelo wo kambela. Eka ku humesa ka data hinkwayo ku nghenisiwa bodo yo sungula.
import-board-instruction-planka: Tsala adirese ya Planka ya wena (xikombiso https://planka.example.com), vito ro tirhisa na xiletelo xa xihundla xa Planka, kutani u tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo". Swi tirhisiwa ntsena ku teka bodo naswona a swi hlayisiwi. Hlawula bodo kutani u tshikelela "Teka": WeKan yi yi hlaya eka API ya Planka, swin'we ni minxaxamelo, tikhadi, swihlamuselo, masiku yo hetelela, swikombiso, swirho, minxaxamelo ya mintirho ni mavonelo, kutani u ya emahlweni u nghenisa tanihilaha swi tolovelekeke. Tikhadi leti nga eka vuhlayiselo bya Planka ti nghenisiwa ti ri eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale; swiphatisi ni tikhadi leti nga eka thyaka a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: Eka Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), nghena, pfumelela mpfumelelo wa Tasks.Read kutani u kopa token eka thebe ya Access token. Yi namarheta laha kutani u tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo"; token yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka loku naswona a yi hlayisiwi. Hlawula minxaxamelo hinkwayo kumbe nxaxamelo wun'we kutani u tshikelela "Teka". Nxaxamelo wun'wana ni wun'wana wa To Do wu va nxaxamelo naswona ntirho wun'wana ni wun'wana wu va khadi, ni switsundzuxo swa wona, masiku yo hetelela ni yo sungula, magoza tanihi nxaxamelo wo kambela, mintlawa tanihi swikombiso, nkoka lowukulu ni xiyimo tanihi swikombiso; mintirho leyi hetiweke yi yisiwa eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale. Switsundzuxo ni ku phindha a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: Eka KanbanFlow, pfula menu ya bodo, hlawula Settings → API & Webhooks kutani u kopa API token ya bodo. Namarheta token laha, tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo", hlawula bodo kutani u tshikelela "Teka"; token yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka koloko naswona a yi hlayisiwi. Tikholomo ti va minxaxamelo naswona tindlela ti tshama ti ri tindlela; mintirho yi hlayisa nhlamuselo, muvala, swikombiso, siku ro hetelela, mintirhwana tanihi nxaxamelo wo kambela, nkarhi lowu tirhisiweke, xiringanyeto, vanhu ni mavonelo.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Tsala ID ya akhawunti ya wena ya Basecamp (nomboro leyi landzelaka basecamp.com/ eka adirese) ni token ya ku nghena (ku suka eka app ya OAuth 2 leyi tsarisiweke eka launchpad.37signals.com, kumbe leyi nhlanganiso lowu nga kona wu se wu nga na yona), tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo", hlawula phurojeke kutani u tshikelela "Teka". Token yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka koloko naswona a yi hlayisiwi. Tafula rin'wana ni rin'wana ra tikhadi ri va ndlela leyi tikholomo ta yona ti nga minxaxamelo, naswona minxaxamelo ya swo endliwa yi va ndlela ya "To-dos"; tikhadi ni swo endliwa swi hlayisa matsalwa, masiku, lava averiweke ni mavonelo, magoza ya khadi ma va nxaxamelo wo kambela, naswona leswi hetiweke swi yisiwa eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Kuma token ya ku nghena eka OAuth 2.0 Playground: ehansi ka Tasks API v1 hlawula tasks.readonly, tshikelela Authorize APIs, kutani Exchange authorization code for tokens, u kopa access token. Yi namarheta laha kutani u tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo", hlawula minxaxamelo hinkwayo ya mintirho kumbe wun'we, kutani "Teka". Token yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka loku naswona a yi hlayisiwi. Minxaxamelo ya mintirho yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va tikhadi, ni switsundzuxo, swihlanganisi ni siku ro hetelela; mintirhwana yi va nxaxamelo wo kambela naswona mintirho leyi hetiweke yi nghenisiwa yi ri eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API ya Google Keep i ya tiakhawunti ta Google Workspace ntsena. Kuma token ya ku nghena ya OAuth 2.0 leyi nga na scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (eka OAuth 2.0 Playground loko mufambisi wa Workspace a pfumela, kumbe eka service account leyi nga na ku rhumela ka domain hinkwayo), yi namarheta, tshikelela "Kombisa nxaxamelo" kutani "Teka". Token yi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka loku naswona a yi hlayisiwi. Switsundzuxo swa matsalwa swi va tikhadi eka nxaxamelo wa "Notes", naswona switsundzuxo swa nxaxamelo wo kambela swi va tikhadi eka nxaxamelo wa "Lists" ni swilo swa swona tanihi nxaxamelo wo kambela. Switsundzuxo leswi nga eka thyaka, swiphatisi ni ku avelana a swi nghenisiwi.
api-import-desc: Yi teke eka vukorhokeri hi akhawunti ya wena. Leswi u swi tsalaka laha swi tirhisiwa ntsena eka ku teka loku naswona a swi hlayisiwi.
api-import-fetched: Swi tekiwile. Kambela swirho leswi nga ehansi kutani u nghenisa.
api-import-nothing: A ku na nchumu wo nghenisa hi akhawunti leyi.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: Eka Pivotal Tracker, pfula thebe ya MORE ya phurojeke u hlawula Export CSV (kumbe u hlawula switori u hlawula Bulk Actions, CSV), kutani u namarhela CSV. Xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana xa xitori xi va nxaxamelo naswona switori swi va makhadi, swin'we na muxaka na swikombiso swa swona, vini, mukomberi, masiku, mimbulavulo, mintirho na swisivela; Estimate yi va Story points naswona ku phindha ku va ti-sprint.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: Eka Tasks.org, pfula Settings, Backups u hlawula Export tasks, kutani u namarhela leswi nga eka fayili ya .json. Minxaxamelo yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa, swikombiso, masiku, mimbulavulo na swintirhwana swa yona; mintirho leyi hetiweke yi hlayisa siku ra yona ro hetisa, naswona nkoka wu va xivandla xa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-monday: Eka monday.com, pfula menyu ya bodo, hlawula More actions na Export board to Excel (na ku pfuxeta na swintirhwana loko u swi lava), kutani u hlawula fayili ya .xlsx. Khalomu ya Status yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintlawa yi va tindlela; vanhu, masiku, nxaxamelo wa nkarhi na swikombiso swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona, tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela naswona ku pfuxeta ku va mimbulavulo.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: Eka Super Productivity, pfula Settings, kutani Sync & Backup, hlawula Export Data u namarhela leswi nga eka fayili ya sp-backup .json. Phurojeke yin'wana na yin'wana yi va ndlela naswona mintirho yi va makhadi eka To Do, In Progress, Backlog kumbe Done, swin'we na swilo swo tsundzuxa, swikombiso, siku ro hetelela, nkarhi lowu tirhisiweke na swintirhwana swa yona; mintirho leyi nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale yi va makhadi lama nga eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
import-board-instruction-taiga: Eka Taiga, pfula Admin > Project > Export u dawuniloda ku humesiwa ka phurojeke (pfula fayili ya .json.gz ku sungula), kutani u namarhela JSON ya yona. Swiyimo swa switori swa vatirhisi swi va minxaxamelo, switori swa vatirhisi swi va makhadi na mintirho ya swona tanihi swintirhwana, ti-epic na swiphiqo swi kuma tindlela ta swona, naswona ti-sprint, swikombiso, mimbulavulo na swihlawulekisi swa ku tiendlela swa ta. Swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: Eka Vikunja, pfula Settings, hlawula Data Export u dawuniloda fayili ya .zip leyi yi ku rhumelaka yona, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo, kumbe u namarhela data.json leyi nga endzeni ka yona. Swibakiti swa Kanban swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swikombiso, vaaveriwa, masiku, nhlamuselo, minxaxamelo ya mintirho tanihi minxaxamelo yo kambela na mimbulavulo; nkoka, phesente leyi hetiweke na ku hetisiwa swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-quire: Eka Quire, pfula menyu ya phurojeke u hlawula Export CSV, kutani u namarhela CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na swintirhwana swa yona tanihi makhadi ya vana, vaaveriwa, swikombiso tanihi swikombiso, masiku yo sungula, yo hetelela na yo hetisa, nhlamuselo na nkoka tanihi xivandla xa ku tiendlela. Mimbulavulo na swihlanganisi a swi kona eka CSV ya Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: Eka Wrike, humesa phurojeke kumbe folidara eka Excel, kumbe u tata xikombiso xa ku nghenisa xa Excel xa Wrike, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo ya .xlsx. Mintila ya folidara na phurojeke yi va tindlela, Status yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi, swin'we na Key, ntirho wa mutswari, vaaveriwa, masiku yo sungula na yo hetelela, swiboho na nhlamuselo swa yona; Priority, Duration na tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: Eka Teamwork.com, tata xikombiso xa ku nghenisa mintirho xa Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) u xi hlayisa tanihi .xlsx, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo. Minxaxamelo ya mintirho yi va minxaxamelo naswona mintirho yi va makhadi; ntirho lowu sungulaka hi -, # kumbe > wu va xintirhwana xa ntirho lowu nga ehenhla ka wona (--, ## kumbe >> xiyimo xin'we ehansi). Vaaveriwa, masiku na swikombiso swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona; Priority, Estimated time na Complete swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: Eka Businessmap (khale a ku ri Kanbanize), pfula Advanced Search, hlawula Configure results u hlawula tikhalomu, dawuniloda fayili ya Excel, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo ya .xlsx. Tikhalomu ti hlayiwa hi mavito ya tona ya Xinghezi (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): loko akhawunti ya wena yi tirhisa ririmi rin'wana, cinca mavito ya layini ya le henhla ma va hi Xinghezi ku sungula. Column yi va minxaxamelo naswona Lane yi va tindlela; vini, swikombiso, muhlovo, masiku, mimbulavulo na tilinki ta vatswari swi hlayisa tindhawu ta swona, naswona Priority, Size, Type na tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-redmine: Eka Redmine, pfula Issues ta phurojeke, hlawula Also available in: CSV ehansi ka nxaxamelo, hlawula tikhalomu (All columns, na Description) u humesa, kutani u namarhela CSV. Redmine yi thya tikhalomu hi ririmi ra wena, hikwalaho veka ririmi ra wena ri va Xinghezi eka My account u nga si humesa. Xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana xi va nxaxamelo naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi, swin'we na tracker tanihi xikombiso, muaveriwa, mutsari, masiku, ntirho wa mutswari na swiphiqo leswi yelanaka; nkoka, xiyenge, vhezheni leyi kongomisiweke, nkarhi lowu ringanyetiweke, % Done na swivandla swa ku tiendlela swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela.
import-board-instruction-notion: Eka Notion, pfula database tanihi tluka hinkwaro, hlawula ••• na Export, hlawula Markdown & CSV, u hlawula fayili ya .zip leyi yi dawunilodaka, kumbe CSV yin'we ya database ku suka eka yona, kumbe u namarhela CSV yoleyo. Khalomu leyi vuriwaka Status yi va minxaxamelo (loko yi nga ri kona, khalomu yo sungula leyi fanaka na select yi endla tano, naswona xiviko xa ku nghenisa xi vula leswaku i yihi); mintila yi va makhadi swin'we na nhloko-mhaka ya wona, swikombiso tanihi swikombiso, vanhu tanihi swirho, masiku, na tsalwa ra tluka tanihi nhlamuselo; tikhalomu tin'wana ti va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Vuxaka, swifaniso na swihlanganisi a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-plane: Eka Plane, pfula Workspace Settings, hlawula Exports, humesa tiphurojeke tanihi JSON, CSV kumbe Excel u dawuniloda fayili ya .zip, kutani u hlawula fayili yoleyo, kumbe fayili yin'we ku suka endzeni ka yona, kumbe u namarhela JSON kumbe CSV. Swiyimo swi va minxaxamelo, tiphurojeke ti va tindlela, naswona swiphiqo swi va makhadi swin'we na xihlawulekisi, mutswari, vaaveriwa, swikombiso, masiku, tilinki na mimbulavulo swa swona; nkoka, xilinganiso, xirhendzevutani na mojulu swi va swivandla swa ku tiendlela. Ku humesa ka Plane a ku na tinhlamuselo kumbe swihlanganisi, hikwalaho a swi nghenisiwi.
import-board-instruction-trello: Eka bodo ya wena ya Trello, yana eka 'Menu', kutani 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', kutani u kopa tsalwa leri humaka.
import-board-instruction-csv: Namarheta Comma Separated Values(CSV)/ Tab Separated Values (TSV) ya wena .
import-board-instruction-jira: Namarheta JSON ya ku lavisisa timhaka ta Jira Cloud: GET /rest/api/3/search/jql?jql=project=KEY&fields=*all&expand=names,schema (handle ka fields yi tlherisa ti-id ta swivutiso ntsena). Phurojeke leyikulu yi ta hi matluka, rin'wana na rin'wana ri ri na nextPageToken ya leri landzelaka: veka swivutiso swa matluka hinkwawo eka nxaxamelo wun'we wa "issues", kumbe u nghenisa tluka rin'wana na rin'wana tanihi bodo ya rona hi Nghenisa tibodo to tala. Xilo xo fana na { "issues": [...] } na xona xa tirha. Swiyimo swa Jira swi hundzuka minxaxamelo naswona swivutiso swi hundzuka makhadi. Loko u lava, katsa nxaxamelo wa "automationRules" ku nghenisa milawu.
import-board-instruction-excel: Hlawula buku ya ntirho ya .xlsx: tafula leri nga na khadi rin'we eka layini yin'wana na yin'wana (tikholomu to fana na Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, masiku na tinsimu to tiendlela), kumbe buku ya ntirho leyi WeKan yi yi humeseke, na yona leyi nga na bodo yin'wana na yin'wana eka phepha ra yona. Goza leri landzelaka ri komba leswaku kholomu yin'wana na yin'wana i nsimu yihi. Phepha rin'wana na rin'wana leri nga na layini ya tinhloko ri hundzuka bodo.
import-board-instruction-wekan: Eka bodo ya wena, famba eka 'Menyu', endzhaku ka sweswo eka 'Humesa bodo', u kopa tsalwa leri nga eka fayili leyi dawunilodiweke.
import-board-instruction-about-errors: Loko u kuma swihoxo loko u nghenisa bodo, minkarhi yin'wana ku nghenisa ka ha tirha, naswona bodo yi kumeka eka tluka ra Tibodo Hinkwato.
import-without-mapping-members: Nghenisa handle ko fambelanisa swirho (fambelanisa endzhaku)
import-members-mode-map: Hlawula mutirhisi la nga kona eka un'wana na un'wana wa vona
import-members-mode-placeholder: Va hlayise tanihi vatirhisi va xivandla na mavito ya vona, ku va fambelanisa na vatirhisi va xiviri endzhaku
import-members-mode-me: Va endle hinkwavo va va mina
csv-mapping-description: Hlawula khalomu ya fayili leyi khomaka xivandla xin'wana na xin'wana xa khadi. Swihlawulo swi endliwile hi ku ya hi mavito ya tikhalomu; cinca leswi hoxeke, naswona hlawula (a yi kona eka fayili) eka xivandla lexi fayili yi nga riki na xona.
csv-mapping-list-missing: Fayili a yi na khalomu ya nxaxamelo. Hlawula yin'we laha henhla, kumbe u tsala vito ra nxaxamelo wun'we lowu makhadi hinkwawo ma yaka eka wona.
csv-mapping-list-name: Nxaxamelo wa khadi rin'wana na rin'wana
csv-mapping-custom-fields: Tikhalomu tin'wana to nghenisa tanihi swivandla swa ku tiendlela swa tsalwa:
csv-mapping-boards: Tluka rin'wana na rin'wana ri va bodo ya rona:
csv-mapping-title-required: Hlawula khalomu leyi khomaka tinhloko-mhaka ta makhadi.
csv-mapping-list-required: Tsala vito ra nxaxamelo lowu makhadi hinkwawo ma yaka eka wona, kumbe u hlawula khalomu leyi khomaka nxaxamelo.
invalid-import-mapping: Ku fambelanisa ka tikhalomu a ku fambelani na fayili.
import-many-boards-hint: Hlawula tifayili to tala to humesa ta xitirho lexi, kumbe .zip yin'we leyi ti khomaka: fayili yin'wana na yin'wana yi va bodo ya yona, yi nghenisiwa handle ka ku fambelanisa swirho. .zip leyi yi nga ku humesa kun'we (Vikunja, Notion, Plane, kumbe WeKan na swihlanganisi) i bodo yin'we. Loko tifayili ti hlawuriwile laha, Nghenisa yi ti nghenisa ematshan'wini ya xivandla lexi nga laha henhla.
import-one-board-per-project: Bodo yin'we eka phurojeke yin'wana na yin'wana
import-one-board-per-project-hint: Ndlela yin'wana na yin'wana leyi ku nghenisa a ku ta yi endla (phurojeke, folidara kumbe nxaxamelo wa xitirho) yi va bodo ya yona. Makhadi ya vatswari na swiboho exikarhi ka tibodo toleto swi kombisiwa eka xiviko xa ku nghenisa.
export-all-boards-hint: Bodo yin'wana na yin'wana leyi u nga yi humesaka, eka ku dawuniloda kun'we: Excel tanihi buku yin'we ya ntirho na tluka eka bodo yin'wana na yin'wana leri thyiweke hi yona, fomati yin'wana na yin'wana tanihi .zip na fayili eka bodo yin'wana na yin'wana.
import-json-placeholder: Namarheta data ya wena ya JSON leyi faneleke laha
import-csv-placeholder: Namarheta data ya wena ya CSV/TSV leyi faneleke laha
import-json-file: Kumbe hlawula fayili ya Trello JSON
import-attachments-zip: ZIP ya swikhomanisiwa swa Trello (a swi bohi, ku suka eka Trello Card Attachments Downloader)
import-trello-json-file-hint: Bodo yin'we ya Trello leyi humesiweke tanihi .json. Loko u hlayisile xilotlelo xa Trello API na thokeni, swikhomanisiwa swa yona, xifaniso xa le ndzhaku xa bodo na swifaniso swa swirho na swona swa dawunilodiwa.
import-trello-zip-file-hint: Fayili ya .zip leyi nga na fayili yin'we kumbe ku tlula ya bodo ya .json na swikhomanisiwa swa tona eka tifolidara ta vito ra bodo (ku suka eka Trello Card Attachments Downloader). Tibodo hinkwato ta nghenisiwa.
import-trello-zip-no-boards: A ku kumekanga tifayili ta .json ta bodo ya Trello eka .zip.
import-trello-zip-progress: Ku nghenisa tibodo ku suka eka .zip, ndza kombela u rindza…
import-trello-failed: Ku nghenisa ku suka eka Trello ku tsandzekile.
import-timeout: Ku nghenisa ku teke nkarhi wo leha ngopfu kutani ku yimisiwile. Ndza kombela u ringeta nakambe; loko swi ya emahlweni swi humelela, bodo yi nga ha va yi kulu ngopfu kumbe database yi nga ha va yi khomekile.
import-too-large: Fayili yi kulu ngopfu leswaku yi nghenisiwa hi nkarhi wun'we. Yi avanyise yi va tifayili titsongo, xikombiso hi phurojeke kumbe hi siku, kutani u nghenisa yin'wana na yin'wana.
import-trello-zip-read-failed: A swi kotekanga ku hlaya .zip leyi khandziyisiweke.
import-trello-zip-too-many-files: .zip yi na tifayili to tala ngopfu ku nghenisiwa.
import-trello-zip-file-too-large: Fayili leyi nga endzeni ka .zip yi kulu ngopfu ku nghenisiwa.
import-trello-zip-unsafe-path: .zip yi na tindlela ta tifayili leti nga hlayisekangiki kutani yi aliwile.
import-trello-workspace: Vito ra ndhawu ya vutirheli ya wena (a swi bohi)
import-attachment-auth-hint: Ku humesa ku vula mavito ya swihlanganisi swa kona kambe a ku rhwali tifayili. Ku ti tisa, nyika adirese ya vukorhokeri na ku nghena: swi tirhisiwa eka ku nghenisa loku ntsena, swi rhumeriwa eka adirese yoleyo ntsena, naswona a swi hlayisiwi nikatsongo. Siya ku nga ri na nchumu ku nghenisa handle ka tifayili.
import-attachment-auth-token: Thokheni ya API, xilotlelo xa API kumbe xiletelo xa xihundla xa app
import-trello-workspace-placeholder: Bodo leyi nghenisiweke yi vekiwa ehansi ka ndhawu leyi ya vutirheli, leyi endliwaka loko yi nga ri kona
import-trello-parent-workspace: Veka tindhawu ta vutirheli leti nghenisiweke ehansi ka
trello-api-import: Nghenisa hi ku kongoma ku suka eka Trello hi xilotlelo xa API na thokeni
trello-api-import-desc: Namarheta xilotlelo xa wena xa Trello API na thokeni ku nxaxameta tindhawu ta vutirheli na tibodo ta wena ta Trello, kutani u nghenisa leti hlawuriweke swin'we na swikhomanisiwa swa tona.
trello-api-key: Xilotlelo xa Trello API (ku suka eka https://trello.com/app-key)
trello-api-token: Thokeni ya Trello API (leyi endliweke hi voko ehansi ka khii ya API)
trello-list-workspaces: Nxaxameta tindhawu ta vutirheli ta Trello
trello-api-credentials-required: Ndza kombela u nghenisa xilotlelo xa Trello API na thokeni swa mbirhi.
trello-api-credentials-saved: Xilotlelo xa Trello API na thokeni swi hlayisiwile. U nga nxaxameta tindhawu ta vutirheli handle ko swi nghenisa nakambe.
trello-export-desc: Endla khopi ya bodo leyi eka Trello hi ku tirhisa API ya Trello, hi khiya ya wena ya Trello API na thokeni. Tindlela ti va swikombiso leswi thyiweke "Swimlane: …", leswi ku nghenisa ka Trello ka WeKan ku swi vuyiselaka eka tindlela.
trello-export-warnings: A hi swilo hinkwaswo leswi koteke ku humesiwa
sandstorm-trello-access-needed: Grain ya Sandstorm a yi na mfikelelo wa yona wa Inthanete. Pfumelela grain leyi ku fikelela Trello ku sungula.
sandstorm-trello-access-granted: Grain leyi yi nga fikelela Trello.
sandstorm-trello-save-label: Trello, ku nghenisa na ku humesa tibodo
trello-select-boards: Ndza kombela u hlawula bodo yin'we ku nghenisa.
trello-cancel-delete-confirm: Khansela ku nghenisa u susa tibodo leti se ti nghenisiweke hi ntirho lowu? Leswi a swi koti ku tlheriseriwa.
import-members-map: Bodo ya wena leyi nghenisiweke yi na swirho swin'wana. Ndza kombela u fambelanisa swirho leswi u lavaka ku swi nghenisa na vatirhisi va wena
import-members-map-note: Xiya: Swirho leswi nga fambelanisiwangiki swi ta averiwa mutirhisi wa sweswi.
import-user-select: Hlawula mutirhisi wa wena loyi a nga kona loyi u lavaka ku n'wi tirhisa tanihi xirho lexi
version-check-failed: A swi koteki ku kambela nomboro ya vuhundzuluxi.
invalid-year: Lembe leri nga tirhiki. Ndza kombela u tsala tinomboro hinkwato ta mune, xikombiso 2026.
just-invited: U ha ku rhambiwa eka bodo leyi
shared-labels-desc: Swikombiso leswi hlayisiweke laha swi nga tirhisiwa eka tibodo to tala, etlhelo ka swikombiso swa bodo yin'wana na yin'wana. Ku cinca vito kumbe muvala wa xin'we laha swi xi cinca eka bodo yin'wana na yin'wana leyi xi tirhisaka; ku susa xin'we swi xi siya eka tibodo teto tanihi xikombiso xa tona.

Ku humesa ku tsala minxaxamelo ya bodo leyi tanihi yin'we, leyi thyiweke hi bodo, eka JSON leyi API ya Wrike yi yi vuyisaka ya tindlela ta ntirho: endla ndlela yoleyo ya ntirho eka Wrike u nga si nghenisa ku humesa ka Excel ka Wrike ka bodo, leswaku swiyimo swa yona swi tirhisiwa. Ku nghenisa ku hlaya JSON yoleyo leyi namarheriweke laha henhla, ku suka eka WeKan kumbe eka GET /workflows ya Wrike, eka bodo leyi hlawuriweke: xiyimo lexi nga riki na nxaxamelo xi va nxaxamelo, naswona nawu wu fungha khadi ri hetisiwile loko ri rhurhiseriwa eka xiyimo xa Completed kumbe Cancelled naswona ri nga hetisiwanga eka xa Active kumbe Deferred. Milawu ya Wrike ya yoxe ya ku tiendlekela a yi koti ku humesiwa eka Wrike.

Loko nkoka wu ri na swivandla kumbe swihlawulekisi swo hlawuleka wu fanele ku pfaleriwa hi swikoweto (xik. `__operator_list__:"To Review"`).

Ku veka `-` emahlweni ka *<field>* swi lavisisa ku pfumaleka ka nkoka eka xivandla xexo (xik. `has:-due` yi lavisisa makhadi lama nga riki na siku ro hetelela).

globalSearch-instructions-notes-1: Switirhisi swo tala swi nga boxiwa.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Swiendli leswi fanaka swi hlanganisiwa hi *OR*.  Makhadi lama fambelanaka na xiyimo xin'wana na xin'wana ma ta vuyisiwa.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` yi ta vuyisa makhadi lama nga eka nxaxamelo wihi na wihi lowu vitaniwaka *Blocked* kumbe *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Swiendli leswi hambaneke swi hlanganisiwa hi *AND*.  Ku vuyisiwa ntsena makhadi lama fambelanaka na swiendli hinkwaswo leswi hambaneke.  `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` yi vuyisa ntsena makhadi lama nga eka nxaxamelo *Available* lama nga na xikombiso xa *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Masiku ma nga boxiwa tanihi nomboro leyi heleleke ya positivhi kumbe ya negativhi kumbe hi ku tirhisa `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` kumbe `__predicate_year__` eka nkarhi wa sweswi.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Ku lavisisa tsalwa a ku hlawuli maletere lamakulu na lamatsongo.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Hi ntolovelo makhadi lama hlayisiweke eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale a ma lavisisiwi.

cron-migrations-retried: Ku rhurhisa loku tsandzekeke ku ringetiwile nakambe hi ku humelela
filesystem-path-description: Ndhawu ya masungulo ya vuhlayiselo bya tifayili
filesystem-disabled: Vuhlayiselo bya Fayilisisiteme a byi Tirhi
filesystem-enabled-description: Tirhisa fayilisisiteme ya laha ka wena ku hlayisa tifayili
s3-minio-storage-description: Vuhlayiselo bya swilo lebyi fambelanaka na S3: AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Backblaze B2, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces na swin'wana.
s3-force-path-style: Sindzisa ti-URL ta xivumbeko xa ndlela
s3-force-path-style-description: Swi laveka hi MinIO na tisevha to tala leti fambelanaka na S3 leti nga riki ta AWS.
azure-connection-string-description: Swa ku tihlawulela: tirhisa xiletelo xo hlanganisa hinkwaxo ematshan'weni ya vito ra akhawunti na khiya.
database-migration-description: Rhurhisa data ya marito (hinkwayo handle ka swikhomanisiwa na swifaniso swa phurofayili, leswi tshamaka eka fayilisisiteme) exikarhi ka MongoDB na FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Dathabeyisi yin'wana yi fanele yi tirha naswona yi fikeleleka (tiphoto ta ntolovelo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; cinca hi WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Loko swi hetile, kongomisa MONGO_URL eka dathabeyisi yin'wana kutani u sungula WeKan nakambe (eka Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb kumbe =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Rhurhisa data ya marito eka FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migrate-to-mongodb: Rhurhisa data ya marito eka MongoDB
database-migration-confirm: Kopa minhlengeletano hinkwayo ya marito eka __db__? Swikhomanisiwa na swifaniso swa phurofayili eka fayilisisiteme a swi khumbiwi. Dathabeyisi leyi kongomisiweke yi fanele yi tirha.
database-migration-done: Ku rhurhisa data ya marito ku hetisisiwile.
sandstorm-migration-description: Loko WeKan yi tirha endzeni ka grain ya Sandstorm, dathabeyisi ya yona ya khale ya MongoDB 3 yi rhurhisiwa eka FerretDB v1 (SQLite) loko yi sungula ro sungula, naswona swikhomanisiwa na swifaniso swa phurofayili swi susiwa eka dathabeyisi swi yisiwa eka tifolidara ta grain ta files/attachments na files/avatars. Leswi swi komba loko ku rhurhisa koloko ku humelerile, na ndhawu ya disk leyi tifayili ta khale ta MongoDB ta xiviri ta ha yi tirhisaka endzeni ka grain, naswona swi ku pfumelela ku susa tifayili toleto ku ntshunxa ndhawu.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb: Tifayili ta xiviri ta dathabeyisi ya MongoDB 3
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Susa tifayili ta xiviri ta dathabeyisi ya MongoDB
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Endzhaku ka ku rhurhisa loku humeleleke, data yi tshama eka FerretDB na le ka fayilisisiteme, hikwalaho tifayili ta khale ta xiviri ta dathabeyisi ya MongoDB 3 ti nga susiwa ku ntshunxa ndhawu ya disk ya grain. Leswi a swi koti ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Susa tifayili ta xiviri ta dathabeyisi ya MongoDB 3 ku ntshunxa ndhawu ya disk? Data se yi rhurhisiwile eka FerretDB na le ka fayilisisiteme. Leswi a swi koti ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Tifayili ta xiviri ta dathabeyisi ya MongoDB ti susiwile, ku ntshunxiwile
features-desc: Swihlawulekisi swo tihlawulela leswi WeKan yi swi nyikaka. Xihlawulekisi lexi nga hlawuriwangiki xi fihliwa eka vatirhisi hinkwavo. Data ya xona ya hlayisiwa naswona mpfumelelo a wu cinci.
feature-views-table-desc: Bodo tani hi tafula ra makhadi lama nga longoloxiwaka.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Khalendara ni khalendara ya tibodo to tala.
feature-views-overview-desc: Tinhlayo, ku hlanganisa hi munhu loyi a nyikiweke ntirho, kungu ra ndlela, deshibodo ni bodo leyikulu.
feature-views-gantt-desc: Tindlela tinharhu to languta tichati ta Gantt.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Mintirho ya xitirhisiwa leyi saleke, minkarhi yo koma ya ku tirha, xiviko xa nkarhi wolowo ni rivilo ra ku tirha.
feature-views-flow-charts: Tichati ta ku khuluka ka mintirho
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Mintirho leyi saleke, mintirho leyi hetiweke, ku khuluka loku hlengeletiweke, nkarhi wo tirha ni wo rindza, nhlayo ya mintirho leyi hetiweke, nkarhi lowu mintirho yi wu heteke yi rindzile, swihingakanyi, Monte Carlo ni swipimo swin'wana swa ku khuluka ka mintirho.
feature-views-map-desc: Makhadi tani hi swikombiso eka xifaniso lexi layichiweke.
feature-approval-required: Siya swihlawulekisi leswi engeteriweke hi mimpfuxeto ya WeKan swi nga tirhi ku fikela loko mulawuri a swi pfulela
feature-preview-admins: Valawuri va vona swihlawulekisi leswi nga tirheki leswaku va ta swi ringeta ku sungula
feature-pilot-users: Vatirhisi vo ringeta lava tlhelaka va vona swihlawulekisi leswi nga tirheki
feature-pilot-users-placeholder: Mavito ya vatirhisi, lama hambanisiweke hi tikhoma
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Swi hlayisiwile. Mavito lawa ya vatirhisi a ma kumekanga:
card-field-visibility-desc: Swivandla swa Swipimelo swa Bodo / Khadi leswi tibodo ti nga swi kombisaka. Xivandla lexi nga funghiwangiki xi fihliwa eka khadi rin'wana na rin'wana, khadi lerintsongo na Swipimelo swa Bodo / Khadi swa bodo yin'wana na yin'wana. A ku cinci data ya khadi kumbe ku veka ka bodo, naswona ku xi fungha nakambe ku kombisa bodo yin'wana na yin'wana hilaha a yi vekiwile hakona. Nxaxamelo wa swivandla i wa bodo yin'wana na yin'wana.
cards-loading-auto: Hi xoxe (hi ku olova ntsena eka tibodo letikulu)
cards-loading-lazy: Hi ku olova (makhadi lama vonakaka ntsena)
cards-loading-description: WeKan yi layicha makhadi ya bodo hi xoxe: bodo leyikulu (leyi tlulaka mpimo) yi layicha makhadi lama vonakaka sweswi ntsena (ku rhendzela loku nga heriki) swin'we na nhlayo leyi hanyaka, leswaku yi tshama yi hatlisa naswona yi tirhisa memori na bandwidth swi nga tali, kasi tibodo letitsongo ti layicha khadi rin'wana na rin'wana leswaku ku va na ntokoto wo olova lowu heleleke. A ku na leswi faneleke ku vekiwa. Vatirhisi va sevha va ha swi kota ku sindzisa ndlela hi swiyenge swa mbango swa CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) na CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Ku layicha makhadi hi ku olova i ka ndzingeto: swihlayi swa makhadi na mimpimo ya WIP swi lulamile, kambe mavonelo ya Khalendara/Thebulu/Gantt na ku hlawula ko tala swi komba makhadi lama layichiweke ku fikela sweswi ntsena. Layicha tibodo leti pfulekeke nakambe endzhaku ka ku cinca leswi.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, tilinki hinkwato (tilinki ta markdown to fana na [label](url) na tithegi ta HTML <a href>) ti tshama ti kombiwa tanihi marito ntsena lama nga tshikeleriwiki eka xiphemu xin'wana na xin'wana xa marito lama fuweke (tinhloko ta tibodo na makhadi, tinhlamuselo, mbulavulo, minxaxamelo yo kambela, na swin'wana). Leswi swi sivela tilinki leti xisetelaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile, hikwalaho tilinki ti tshama ti tshikeleriwa.
always-show-code-as-text: Minkarhi hinkwayo komba khodi hinkwayo tanihi marito ntsena
always-show-code-as-text-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, marito lama fuweke a ma kombiwi tanihi markdown kumbe HTML: xihlovo hinkwaxo xi tshama xi kombiwa tanihi marito ntsena eka xiphemu xin'wana na xin'wana xa marito lama fuweke (tinhloko ta tibodo na makhadi, tinhlamuselo, mbulavulo, minxaxamelo yo kambela, na swin'wana). Leswi swi paluxa leswi fihliweke — mbulavulo wa HTML (<!-- -->), laha tilinki ta markdown ti kongomaka kona, JavaScript na khodi yin'wana — leswaku khodi hinkwayo yi tshama yi vonaka, yi nga tshikeleriwi, naswona yi nga tirhi. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile, hikwalaho markdown yi kombiwa hi ndlela ya ntolovelo.
disable-all-import-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, swiendlo hinkwaswo swa ku nghenisa swa tsimiwa: ku nghenisa bodo ku suka eka WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea na Forgejo, swin'we na ku kopa bodo. Swihlawulekisi swa menyu ya ku nghenisa swa fihliwa naswona sevha yi ala xikombelo xin'wana na xin'wana xa ku nghenisa. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
disable-all-export-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, swiendlo hinkwaswo swa ku humesa swa tsimiwa: ku humesa bodo tanihi WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, kumbe eka NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, na ku humesa xikhomanisiwa xin'we. Swihlawulekisi swa menyu ya ku humesa swa fihliwa naswona sevha yi ala xikombelo xin'wana na xin'wana xa ku humesa. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
disable-import-avatars-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, swifaniso swa phurofayili swa vatirhisi a swi nghenisiwi nikatsongo. Leswi swi katsa ku nghenisa ka WeKan JSON, ku nghenisa ka Trello, na ku fambelanisa swifaniso swa phurofayili ku suka eka vanyiki va vutivi bya le handle loko ku nghenwa (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Mavito na data yin'wana swa ha nghenisiwa; swifaniso swa phurofayili ntsena hi swona swi tsemiwaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
disable-export-avatars-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, swifaniso swa phurofayili swa vatirhisi a swi katsiwi nikatsongo loko bodo yi humesiwa (ku humesa ka WeKan JSON na CSV). Mavito ya ku tirhisa na data yin'wana swa ha humesiwa; swifaniso swa phurofayili ntsena hi swona swi siyiwaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
anonymize-import-users-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, ku nghenisa bodo ya WeKan JSON swi siva vito ro tirhisa, vito hinkwaro na masungulo ya vito ya mutirhisi un'wana na un'wana loyi a nghenisiweke hi swinyikiwa swa nhlayo (user1, user2, ...), swi susa xifaniso xa yena xa phurofayili, naswona swi tsala nakambe ku vitaniwa ka @username (na swiphemu swa lowu kombeleke / lowu averiweke) endzeni ka leswi nghenisiweke swa makhadi na mbulavulo. A ku hlayisiwi vutivi bya xiviri bya mutirhisi ku suka eka bodo ya xihlovo. Rito "user" ri landzela ririmi ra munhu loyi a nghenisaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
anonymize-export-users-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, ku humesa bodo swi siva vito ro tirhisa, vito hinkwaro na masungulo ya vito ya mutirhisi un'wana na un'wana loyi a humesiweke hi swinyikiwa swa nhlayo (user1, user2, ...), swi susa xifaniso xa yena xa phurofayili, naswona swi tsala nakambe ku vitaniwa ka @username (na swiphemu swa lowu kombeleke / lowu averiweke) endzeni ka leswi nga eka makhadi na mbulavulo. Fayili leyi humesiweke a yi na vutivi bya xiviri bya mutirhisi. Rito "user" ri landzela ririmi ra munhu loyi a humesaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Xana u tiyisile leswaku u lava ku fihla vutivi bya akhawunti leyi? Leswi swi siva hilaha ku nga heriki vito ro tirhisa, vito hinkwaro na adirese ya imeyili hi swinyikiwa leswi fihlaka vutivi, swi susa xifaniso xa phurofayili, naswona swi tsima ku nghena. Ku hambana na ku susa, tibodo, makhadi na mbulavulo swi hlayisa matimu ya swona naswona swa ha komba akhawunti leyi, ntsena vutivi bya yona byi fihliwile. Xiendlo lexi a xi koti ku tlheriseriwa endzhaku.
disable-activities-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, swiendlo swa xinkwaxi xa migingiriko a swi tsariwi nikatsongo naswona a swi kombiwi kun'wana (bara ya le tlhelo ya bodo na xiphemu xa migingiriko xa khadi). A ku hlayisiwi matimu ya leswaku i mani a endleke yini. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
disable-notifications-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, WeKan a yi rhumeli matitivisi ya ku langutisa (eka app, hi imeyili kumbe hi vukorhokeri byin'wana) eka migingiriko yin'wana na yin'wana. Migingiriko ya ha swi kota ku tsariwa (handle ka loko na yona yi tsimiwile laha henhla); matitivisi ntsena hi wona ma sivelaka. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
disable-watch-description: Loko swi pfuriwile, xiendlo xa ku langutisa xa tsimiwa — vatirhisi a va swi koti ku tsarisela tibodo, minxaxamelo kumbe makhadi ku kuma matitivisi, naswona ku ringeta kun'wana na kun'wana ku cinca levhele ya ku langutisa ku aleriwa. Hi ntolovelo swi tsimiwile.
backup-description: Endla khopi ya vuhlayiselo ya swikhomanisiwa, swifaniso swa vatirhisi na/kumbe datha (mintlawa hinkwato ya matsalwa leyi nga riki swikhomanisiwa kumbe swifaniso swa vatirhisi). Fayili ya .zip yi rhumeriwa hi ku kongoma eka vuhlayiselo byi hlawuriweke, ku nga ri na fayili ya xinkarhana, yi ri backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, leyi nga ni YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars na /data. Vuhlayiselo bya le mapapeni (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) byi tirhisa vuxokoxoko byo tiyisisa vutitivisi byi lulamisiweke eka tithebhu ta byona ta vuhlayiselo.
backup-scope-description: Sisiteme hinkwayo, kumbe Nhlangano wun'we. Khopi ya vuhlayiselo ya Nhlangano yi katsa tibodo ta wona na hinkwaswo leswi nga eka tona, ku katsa na swikhomanisiwa swa tibodo toleto — kambe a yi na tiakhawunti ta vatirhisi naswona a yi na swiyimiso swa sisiteme, hikuva swona swi avelaniwa hi Nhlangano wun'wana na wun'wana. Ku vuyisa khopi ya vuhlayiselo ya Nhlangano swi tsala ntsena eka tibodo leti Nhlangano wolowo wu ti n'winyaka.
theme-override-all-tenants: Ku siva loku tirhaka eka vapangisi hinkwavo
continuous-backup: Khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi yaka mahlweni
continuous-backup-description: Yi rhumela ku cinca kun'wana ni kun'wana ka vuhlayiselo bya datha, swikhomanisiwa, swifaniso swa vatirhisi ni tirhekhodo eka foldara hi tisekondi ti nga ri tingani, leswaku ku vuyiseriwa xiyimo xa nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana. Yi tirha swin'we ni khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi vekeriweke nkarhi, leyi tumbuluxaka vuhlayiselo byo helela.
continuous-backup-enabled: Tirhisa khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi yaka mahlweni eka sevha leyi
continuous-backup-target: Foldara leyi ku yaka eka yona (ndlela leyi heleleke eka disiki yin'wana, ndhawu leyi avelaniwaka eka netiweke kumbe ndhawu leyi hlanganisiweke hi rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-oplog: Oplog (hi nkarhi wa xiviri, ku cinca kun'wana ni kun'wana)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Mapheji ya SQLite (mapheji lama cinceke eka nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (nongonoko lowu u nga hlawulaka ku wu nghenisa)
continuous-backup-engine-none: A ku na njhini ya vuhlayiselo bya datha leyi nga tirhaka eka sevha leyi
continuous-backup-sqlite-interval: Nkarhi wa le xikarhini wa SQLite (tisekondi)
continuous-backup-base-every: Endla khopi leyintshwa ya masungulo endzhaku ka (tiawara)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Fihla khopi ya vuhlayiselo hi khodi (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Fayili ya xilotlelo xo fihla hi khodi (ndlela leyi heleleke ehandle ka foldara leyi ku yaka eka yona; maletere ya 64 swa sisiteme ya tinomboro leyi sekeriweke eka 16 kumbe xivulwana xa xihundla lexi nga ni maletere ya 16 kumbe ku tlurisa). Hlayisa khopi: handle ka fayili leyi, khopi ya vuhlayiselo a yi nge vuyiseriwi.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Ku hava ndhawu (eka foldara leyi ku yaka eka yona ntsena)
continuous-backup-upload-prefix: Foldara endzeni ka xibye xa vuhlayiselo
continuous-backup-litestream-binary: Fayili leyi tirhisiwaka ya Litestream (ndlela leyi heleleke)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fayili ya vuhlayiselo bya datha ya SQLite (yi tumbuluxiwa etlhelo ka khopi ya vuhlayiselo, a yi tsali ehenhla ka fayili leyi tirhisiwaka nikatsongo)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Tirhisa vuhlayiselo bya datha bya SQLite lebyi akiweke nakambe loko sisiteme yi sungula nakambe nkarhi lowu landzelaka (vuhlayiselo bya datha bya khale lebyi siviweke byi ta hlayisiwa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Vuyisela xitukulwana lexi hlawuriweke eka xiyimo xa nkarhi lowu hlawuriweke? Khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi yaka mahlweni yi ta yima swa xinkarhana loko ku vuyiseriwa.
continuous-backup-saved: Swiletelo swa khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi yaka mahlweni swi hlayisiwile
backup-restore-select-first: Hlawula khopi ya vuhlayiselo eka nxaxamelo ku sungula.
backup-restore-confirm: Vuyisela khopi ya vuhlayiselo leyi hlawuriweke? Swikhomanisiwa ni swifaniso swa vatirhisi swi ta tsariwa eka sisiteme ya tifayili, naswona datha yi ta tsariwa eka vuhlayiselo bya datha hi ku ya hi ndlela leyi hlawuriweke.
gcs-key-filename: Ndhawu ya fayili ya khiya ya akhawunti ya vukorhokeri
gcs-key-filename-description: Swa ku tihlawulela: ndhawu ya fayili ya khiya ya JSON ya akhawunti ya vukorhokeri eka sevha.
gcs-credentials: Swikombiso swa vutivi swa akhawunti ya vukorhokeri (JSON)
gcs-credentials-description: Swa ku tihlawulela: namarhetela khiya ya JSON ya akhawunti ya vukorhokeri. Siya swi nga tsariwanga ku tirhisa fayili ya khiya kumbe swikombiso swa vutivi swa ntolovelo.
gcs-permissions-note: Nyika akhawunti ya vukorhokeri ya WeKan mpfumelelo wo hlaya/ku tsala eka bakiti: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bakiti ya wena → Permissions → Grant access. Eka "New principals", namarhetela imeyili ya akhawunti ya vukorhokeri — nkoka wa "client_email" ku suka eka khiya ya wena ya JSON — kutani u hlawula xiave xa "Storage Object Admin" u tlhela u tshikelela Save.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Siya swi nga tsariwanga ku hlayisa nkoka wa sweswi.
azure-account-name-description: Vito ra akhawunti ya wena ya Azure Storage.
azure-container-description: Xikhomeli xa blob xo hlayisela tifayili eka xona.
gcs-project-id-description: Nomboro ya vutivi ya phurojeke ya wena ya Google Cloud.
gcs-bucket-description: Vito ra bakiti ya Cloud Storage yo hlayisela tifayili eka yona.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: siya swi nga tsariwanga (yi tirhisa endpoint ya xifundzha). Leswi fambelanaka na S3: Endpoint URL ku suka eka khonsolo ya wena ya MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bakiti ya wena → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → vito ra bakiti ya wena (kumbe Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → mutirhisi wa wena → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → hlawula xitirhiso xa 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Yi kombiwa tanihi 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Xikirini xin'we na xa Access key ID; 'Secret access key' yi kombiwa kan'we ntsena loko khiya yi endliwa — yi kope hi nkarhi wolowo (kumbe Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhawunti ya wena → vito ri kombiwa ehenhla (na le hansi ka Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhawunti ya wena → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhawunti ya wena → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → akhawunti ya wena → Data storage → Containers → xikhomeli xa wena (kumbe + Container ku endla xin'wana).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → muhlawuri wa phurojeke ehenhla → ID ya phurojeke ya wena (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → vito ra bakiti ya wena (kumbe Create ku endla yin'wana).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Ndhawu eka sevha ya WeKan ya fayili ya khiya ya JSON ya akhawunti ya vukorhokeri leyi dawunilodiweke (leyi endliwaka laha hansi). Tirhisa leswi KUMBE u namarhetela JSON eka xiphemu lexi nga laha hansi.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → akhawunti ya wena ya vukorhokeri → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (yi dawunilodha fayili). Namarhetela leswi nga endzeni ka yona laha, kumbe u hlayisa fayili u veka ndhawu ya yona laha henhla.
cloud-secret-set: (yi hlayisiwile — siya swi nga tsariwanga ku yi hlayisa)
cloud-settings-save-failed: Ku hlayisa swiyimiso swa vuhlayiselo swi tsandzekile
attachment-move-storage-azure: Rhurhisela xikhomanisiwa eka Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Rhurhisela xikhomanisiwa eka Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Tirhisa MongoDB GridFS ku hlayisa tifayili
s3-disabled: Vuhlayiselo bya S3/MinIO a byi Tirhi
migration-pause-failed: Ku yimisa nkarhinyana ku rhurhisa swi tsandzekile
migration-paused: Ku rhurhisa ku yimisiwile hi ku humelela
migration-start-failed: Ku sungula ku rhurhisa swi tsandzekile
migration-started: Ku rhurhisa ku sunguriwile hi ku humelela
migration-stop-confirm: Xana u tiyisile leswaku u lava ku yimisa ku rhurhisa hinkwako?

sync-conflict-keep-mapping: Khadi leri ri ta tshama ri fambelanisiwile
sync-conflict-detach: Hlayisa leri phindhiweke tanihi khadi ra laha
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Susa ntsena ku fambelanisa ka Sync ka leri phindhiweke. Leswi nga eka rona swi tshama eka WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Ku hlayisela eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale ku siviwile hi makhadi-ntsongo lama tirhaka
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Nchumu wa xihlovo wu hele, kambe makhadi-ntsongo lama tirhaka ma sivela ku hlayiseriwa eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale. Hlayisa khadi leri laha hi ku susa ku fambelanisa ka rona ka Sync. Makhadi-ntsongo a ma cinciwi.
sync-conflict-creation: Endla khadi ra Sync ro siva
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Hlayisa khadi ra khale ri nga cinciwanga u endla khadi rintshwa ra Sync eka nxaxamelo lowu. Ku ringeta nakambe ku tirhisa nakambe leri sivaka.
sync-preview-saved: Swi sekeriwe eka swipimelo leswi hlayisiweke. Ku Fambelanisa sweswi ku teka ni ku kambela xihlovo nakambe.
sync-preview-unavailable: Hlayisa xihlovo xa Sync u nga si kombela ku langutisisa.
sync-preview-blocked: Tlhantlha ku kanetana loku nga laha hansi u nga si kambisisa pulani ya ku cinca.
sync-preview-archive: Hlayisela makhadi eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale
sync-preview-truncated: Ku kombisiwa swingheniso swa 100 swo sungula.
sync-preview-scope: Tinhlayo ti vulavula hi swivandla swa xihlovo leswi tolovelekisiweke. Data yin'wana yi nga siyiwa hi muhlayi wa xihlovo.
sync-preview-excluded: Swi siyiwile hi ku hlawula swivandla loku hlayisiweke
sync-preview-unmapped: Ku hava ku fambelanisa ka Sync
sync-preview-parser-unsupported: Leswi siyiweke leswi vikiweke hi muhlayi
sync-source-heading: Swivandla swa xihlovo leswi nga kopiwangiki hi ku kongoma
sync-source-scope: Tindlela ti hlanganisa ku humelela ka swivandla eka swilo swa xihlovo. Swilo leswi nga fambelanisiwangiki swi vikiwa hinkwaswo; mimpimo ya swona a yi kombisiwi.
sync-source-unmapped: Ku hava ku fambelanisa ka Sync
sync-source-excluded: Swi siyiwile hi ku hlawula swivandla loku hlayisiweke
sync-source-converted: Swi hundzuriwile swi va tsalwa kumbe xikombiso xin'wana
sync-source-fallback: Nkoka wun'wana lowu nga tirhisiwangiki hi muhlayi
sync-source-occurrences: Ku humelela ka swivandla kumbe swilo loku vikiweke
sync-source-truncated: Xiviko xi pimeriwe eka tindlela ta 100 na mavito ya swivandla lama komisiweke.
sync-source-omitted: Ku humelela kun'wana ehandle ka tindlela leti kombisiweke
sync-report-button: Ku tirhisa ka Sync ka sweswinyana
sync-report-retention: Ku tirhisa ka 20 ka sweswinyana. Swiviko swi hlayisiwa masiku ya 30.
sync-report-partial: Ku tirhisa loku tsandzekeke kumbe loku nga hetiwangiki ku nga va ku cincile makhadi man'wana. Swiviko leswi a swi yi emahlweni kumbe ku tlherisela endzhaku ku tirhisa.
sync-report-unfinished: Swa ha endliwa kumbe swi kavanyetiwile; mbuyelo a wu tsariwanga
sync-report-failed: Swi tsandzekile; ku cinca ka xiphemu ku nga humelela
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Swi hetisiwile na swivandla leswi siyiweke kumbe leswi hundzuriweke
sync-report-unavailable: Swiviko swa ku tirhisa swi lava mfikelelo wo tsala eka nxaxamelo hinkwawo na sevha leyi kumekaka.
sync-report-empty: Ku hava ku tirhisa ka Sync loku tsariweke.
sync-recovery-heading: Vulavisisi bya ku tirhisa ka Sync
sync-recovery-description: Swiviko swa Sync leswi hlayisiweke swa masiku ya 30 lama hundzeke. Lavisisa hi ID ya bodo kumbe ya nxaxamelo. Mbuyelo lowu nga hetiwangiki wu nga ha va wa ha tirha kumbe wu kavanyetiwile. Pfuxeta ku kambela nakambe; swiviko leswi a swi koti ku ya emahlweni kumbe ku tlherisela endzhaku ku cinca.
sync-recovery-unavailable: A swi koteki ku hlaya vulavisisi bya Sync. Kambela mfikelelo wa mulawuri na ku kumeka ka sevha.
sync-estimate-field: Xivandla xa xilinganiso xa Jira lexi fambelanisiweke
sync-estimate-field-hint: Hlawula xivandla xa tinomboro lexi nga ni ID ya xivandla xa Jira na yuniti ya xilinganiso, hilaha xi endliweke hakona hi ku nghenisa ka Jira loku fambelanisiweke. Ku cinca ka laha ku kambisisiwa tanihi ku kanetana. Mimpimo ya xihlovo leyi pfumalekaka a yi languteriwi; null leyi boxiweke yi basisa nkoka lowu fambelanisiweke.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab: Nsimu ya nkumbetelo eka bodo leyi
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Ntiko kumbe nkumbetelo wa nkarhi wa GitLab wu tsariwa eka nsimu ya tinomboro leyi u yi hlawulaka. Ku cinca ka laha ku kamberiwa ku ri ku kanetana; mhaka leyi nga riki na ntiko yi sula nkoka lowu hlanganisiweke.
email-recovery-description: Layini yin'we eka muamukeri un'wana ni un'wana. Lava hi ID ya mutirhisi. Vundzeni bya mahungu ni tindhawu ta imeyili ya muamukeri a swi kombisiwi. Ku yimisa swa xinkarhana ku khoma mahungu lama nga kona ni lama nga ta ta; ku ya mahlweni ku ringeta ku rhumela mahungu ya le layinini sweswi. Ku khansela ku susa mahungu lama nghenisiweke elayinini ku fikela enkarhini wa xikombelo. Loko ku rhumela ku ri karhi ku ya mahlweni, ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka nkarhi wo koma. Mahungu lama se ma rhumeriwaka a ma nge tlherisiwi, naswona ku rhumela loku nga tiyisisiwangiki ku nga ha phindhiwa. Ku tsandzeka ka nkarhi hinkwawo ni mahungu lama fikeleleke mpimo wa ku ringeta swi hlayisiwa leswaku swi ta kamberiwa. Ku ringeta nakambe mahungu lama tsandzekeke ku sungula nongonoko lowuntshwa wa ku ringeta naswona ku hlayisa ku yimisiwa ka xinkarhana loku nga kona.
email-recovery-attempts: Nhlayo ya le henhla ya ku ringeta nakambe
email-recovery-changed: Ku cinca ko hetelela ka mutirhisi wa sisiteme
email-recovery-pending: Swi rindzile kumbe swi ringetiwa nakambe
email-recovery-empty: A ku na mahungu elayinini kumbe vaamukeri lava ku rhumela ka vona ku yimisiweke swa xinkarhana.
email-recovery-unavailable: A swi koteki ku hlaya layini ya ti-imeyili. Kambela mpfumelelo wa mulawuri ni ku kumeka ka sevha.
email-recovery-busy: Ku rhumela kumbe tirho wun'wana wa layini wu le ku endleni. Pfuxeta kutani u ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka nkarhi wo koma.
email-recovery-failed: Tirho a wu kotanga ku tiyisisiwa. Pfuxeta layini kutani u ringeta nakambe tirho wolowo loko swi laveka.
email-recovery-superseded: Tirho lowuntshwa wa mutirhisi wa sisiteme wu sive xikombelo lexi. Ku kombisiwa xiyimo xa sweswi xa layini.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Khansela mahungu hinkwawo lama nga elayinini sweswi ya muamukeri loyi? Vundzeni bya wona byi ta susiwa naswona a byi nge vuyisiwi. Mahungu lamantshwa lama endliweke endzhaku ka xikombelo lexi ma ta hlayisiwa.
email-failure-smtp-temporary: Ku ariwa ka SMTP ka nkarhinyana
email-failure-smtp-rejected: Ku ariwa ka SMTP ka masiku hinkwawo
email-failure-smtp-authentication: Ku tiyisisa ka meyili ku lava ku languteriwa
email-failure-smtp-configuration: Ku lulamisiwa ka meyili ku lava ku languteriwa
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Muamukeri a nga kumeki kumbe akhawunti yi timiwile
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Ku fikisiwa a ku tiyisisiwanga; kambisisa u nga si ringeta nakambe
email-failure-acknowledgement-failed: Rhisiti ra ku fikisiwa a ri hlayisekanga
email-failure-delivery-failed: Ku fikisa kumbe ku lulamisela ku tsandzekile
email-failure-retry-limit: Ndzilakano wa ku ringeta hi xoxe wu fikeleriwile
sync-time-estimate-hint: Swilinganiso swa nkarhi swi tirhisa swivandla swa tinomboro swa nkarhi wa masungulo/lowu saleke leswi endliweke hi ku nghenisa ka Jira. Xivandla xin'we ntsena lexi fambelanaka xi fanele ku va kona eka bodo leyi. Ku lulamisa ka laha ku kambisisiwa tanihi ku kanetana; mimpimo ya xihlovo leyi pfumalekaka a yi languteriwi naswona null leyi boxiweke yi basisa nkoka.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint na ku humesiwa swi fambelanisiwa ntsena loko Scrum yi lumekiwile eka bodo leyi. Sprint kumbe ku humesiwa loku pfumalekaka ku endliwa eka bodo leyi, na masiku lama xihlovo xi ma nyikaka; leyi nga kona yi fambelanisiwa hi ID ya yona ya xihlovo ku sungula, kutani hi vito. Ku cinca ka ku pulana ka laha ku tshama ku kondza xihlovo xi cinca ku pulana ka xiphiqo xexo, naswona Ku Fambelanisa ko sungula a ku susi ku pulana nikatsongo.
activity-recovery-description: Switiviso leswi nga hetiwangiki swi ringetiwa nakambe hi swoxe. Kambisisa mintirho leyi pfumalekaka kumbe leyi cinciweke u nga si ringeta nakambe. Ku ringeta nakambe a ku endli ntirho nakambe.
activity-recovery-empty: Ku hava switiviso swa mintirho leswi rindzeleke.
activity-recovery-unavailable: A swi kotekanga ku layicha switiviso swa mintirho leswi rindzeleke.
activity-recovery-retrying: Ku pfuxeta ku fikisiwa ka xitiviso…
activity-recovery-status-processing: Ku vekela ku fikisiwa ku tirha
activity-recovery-status-missing: Ntirho wa masungulo a wu kona
activity-recovery-status-invalid: Metadata ya ku vuyisela a yi tirhi
activity-recovery-status-inconsistent: Pulani na ntirho lowu rindzeleke a swi fambelani
activity-recovery-busy: Mutirhi un'wana u khoma xitiviso lexi. Pfuxeta u ringeta nakambe.
activity-recovery-denied: Mfikelelo wa muamukeri kumbe ku hlawula ka switiviso a ka ha pfumeleli ku fikisiwa.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Ntirho wa masungulo a wu kona kumbe wu cincile. A ku na lexi endliweke nakambe.
activity-recovery-failed: A swi kotekanga ku hetisa ku fikisiwa ka xitiviso. Ntirho lowu rindzeleke wu hlayisiwile.
activity-recovery-paused: Ku fikisiwa ka switiviso swa mintirho ku yimisiwile.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Xitiviso lexi xi cincile ku sukela loko xi layichiwile. Kambisisa xiyimo lexi pfuxetiweke u nga si ringeta nakambe.
activity-recovery-control-failed: A swi kotekanga ku tiyisisa ku veka ka ku fikisiwa. Pfuxeta u kambisisa xiyimo xa xona xa sweswi.
activity-recovery-status-cancelled: Ku fikisiwa ka switiviso swa mintirho ku khanseriwile.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Khansela hi masiku hinkwawo ku fikisiwa loku saleke ka ntirho lowu? Leswi a swi nge yi emahlweni. Timeyili leti se ti nga eka layini na switiviso leswi se swi fikisiweke a swi vuyisiwi.
rule-email-recovery-heading: Ku fikisiwa ka ti-imeyili ta milawu
rule-email-recovery-description: Kambisisa matshalatshala lama rhekhodiweke yo rhumela ti-imeyili ta milawu. Matshalatshala lama nga tiyisisiwangiki ma nga ha va ma ha rhumela kumbe ma kavanyetiwile. Xiviko lexi a xi rhumeli nakambe naswona a xi khanseli ku rhumela.
rule-email-recovery-sent: Yi amukeriwile hi sevha ya imeyili
rule-email-recovery-invalid: Vuxokoxoko byo hlamusela matshalatshala a byi amukeleki
rule-email-recovery-identifiers: Swihlawulekisi swa xileriso / ku vitana / matshalatshala
rule-email-recovery-empty: A ku na matshalatshala yo rhumela ti-imeyili ta milawu lama fambelanaka ni ku lavisisa loku.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: A swi kotekanga ku layicha ku ringeta ka timeyili ta milawu. Pfuxeta u ringeta nakambe.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan a yi pfuki yi rhumele nakambe hi yoxe imeyili leyi nga tiyisisiwangiki. Ku rhumela nakambe ku ya ntsena eka vaamukeri lava nga tiyisisiwangiki. Yi funge leswaku yi rhumeriwile loko u tiva leswaku yi fikile, kumbe u khansela ku rhumela.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Ku rhumela ko sungula ku nga ha va ku ya mahlweni. U nga endla xiboho endzhaku ka __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Rhumela nakambe eka vaamukeri lava nga tiyisisiwangiki
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Rhumela imeyili leyi nakambe eka vaamukeri lava nga tiyisisiwangiki? Munhu loyi sevha ya yena ya imeyili yi amukeleke rungula handle ko tivisa WeKan u ta ri kuma kambirhi.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Funga imeyili leyi leswaku yi rhumeriwile eka vanhu hinkwavu? Endla leswi ntsena loko u tiva leswaku yi fikile.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Khansela ku rhumela imeyili leyi? A yi nge rhumeriwi eka vaamukeri lava nga tiyisisiwangiki.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Ku rhumela ko sungula ku nga ha va ku ya mahlweni. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Ku rhumela nakambe loku sunguleke khale ku nga ha va ku ya mahlweni. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Vaamukeri hinkwavu va tiyisisiwile se. Ematshan'weni yo rhumela nakambe, yi funge leswaku yi rhumeriwile.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Sevha ya imeyili a yi hlamulanga. Rungula leri rhumeriweke nakambe ri nga ha va ri fikile kumbe ri nga fikanga; ri kombisiwa ri ri eku tirheni.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Mulawuri un'wana u le ku lulamiseni ka imeyili leyi. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka xinkarhana.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Imeyili leyi hlayisiweke a ya ha fambelani ni ku ringeta loku, hikokwalaho a yi nge lulamisiwi laha.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Rhekhodo leyi hlayisiweke ya ku ringeta loku a yi tirhi, hikokwalaho a yi nge lulamisiwi laha.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Imeyili leyi a yi kotanga ku lulamisiwa. Pfuxeta tluka kutani u ringeta nakambe.
rule-email-legacy-heading: Timeyili ta milawu leti rindzeleke ku kamberiwa
rule-email-legacy-description: Timeyili leti ta milawu ti lunghisiwe hi vuhundzuluxeri bya khale bya WeKan leri nga rhekhodangiki laha leswi nga endzeni swi humaka kona, hikokwalaho WeKan a yi nge ti rhumeli hi yoxe. Endzhaku ko kambela leswaku mutsari wa nawu u ha ri ni mfanelo yo nghena, hlanganisa imeyili nakambe leswaku yi lunghisiwa hi ku ya hi xiyimo xa sweswi xa khadi, kumbe u yi lahla.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Vuxokoxoko bya khadi bya vuhundzuluxeri bya khale
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Lunghisa imeyili leyi nakambe hi ku ya hi xiyimo xa sweswi xa khadi? Leswi nga endzeni swi nga hambana ni leswi lunghisiweke khale.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Lahla imeyili leyi? A yi nge pfuki yi rhumeriwile.
rule-email-legacy-empty: A ku na timeyili ta milawu leti rindzeleke ku kamberiwa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Timeyili ta milawu leti rindzeleke ku kamberiwa a ti kotanga ku layichiwa. Pfuxeta tluka ku ringeta nakambe.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Mutsari wa nawu a wa ha ri ni mfanelo yo nghena eka khadi leri, kumbe nawu wu cincile, hikokwalaho imeyili a yi nge hlanganisiwi nakambe. U nga yi lahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Xiendlo lexi vangeke imeyili leyi xi cincile, hikokwalaho a yi nge hlanganisiwi nakambe. U nga yi lahla.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Khadi leri imeyili leyi yi humaka eka rona a ra ha kumeki, hikokwalaho a yi nge hlanganisiwi nakambe. U nga yi lahla.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Ku tirhisiwa ka nawu loku lunghiseke imeyili leyi a ka ha hlayisiwanga, hikokwalaho a yi nge hlanganisiwi nakambe. U nga yi lahla.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Imeyili leyi yi rhumeriwile se, ku ringetiwile ku yi rhumela, kumbe yi lahliwile.
rule-email-legacy-not-legacy: Imeyili leyi yi hlanganisiwile nakambe se.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Xiendlo lexi a xi kotanga ku hetiwa. Pfuxeta tluka kutani u ringeta nakambe.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Mintirho ya Ku Fambelanisa Nxaxamelo leyi nga kotiki ku tirhisiwa nakambe
stuck-sync-operation-description: Ntirho wun'wana na wun'wana wa leyi ya Ku Fambelanisa Nxaxamelo leyi hlayisiweke wu yimile exikarhi naswona a wu ha koti ku hetisiwa, hikuva nxaxamelo wa wona wu susiwile, wu endliwile nakambe kumbe wu lulamisiwile nakambe, kumbe mutirhisi loyi a wu sunguleke u lahlekeriwile hi mfikelelo wo tsala. Loko wun'we wu ha rindzele, nxaxamelo wolowo a wu koti ku Fambelanisiwa. Wu lahle leswaku nxaxamelo wu Fambelanisiwa nakambe: ku cinca loku se ku tirhisiweke ku tshama, ku cinca loku saleke loku hlayisiweke a ku tsariwi nikatsongo, naswona Ku Fambelanisa loku landzelaka ku ringanisa nxaxamelo na xihlovo xa wona nakambe.
stuck-sync-operation-applied: __applied__ ka __total__ ka ku cinca ku tirhisiwile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Nxaxamelo wu susiwile, wu endliwile nakambe kumbe swipimelo swa wona swa Sync swi cincile
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Mutirhisi loyi a wu sunguleke a nga ha na mfikelelo wo tsala eka nxaxamelo hinkwawo
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Wu hlayisiwile hi vhezheni ya khale ya WeKan handle ka leswi wu sunguleke
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: Rhekhodo ya leswaku i mani a wu sunguleke a yi kona
stuck-sync-operation-reason-unknown: A swi kotekanga ku kambeleriwa sweswi
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Wu nga tirhisiwa nakambe sweswi naswona wu ta hela hi woxe, hikwalaho a wu koti ku lahliwa.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Lahla ntirho lowu wa Ku Fambelanisa Nxaxamelo lowu hlayisiweke? Ku cinca loku se wu ku tirhiseke ku tshama; loku saleke a ku tsariwi nikatsongo. Kutani nxaxamelo wu nga Fambelanisiwa nakambe.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Ku hava mintirho ya Ku Fambelanisa Nxaxamelo leyi rindzeleke ku kambisisiwa.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ku kombisiwa ya 50 ya khale ngopfu ntsena. Lahla yin'wana u pfuxeta ku vona yin'wana.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: A swi kotekanga ku layicha mintirho ya Ku Fambelanisa Nxaxamelo. Pfuxeta u ringeta nakambe.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: Ntirho lowu a wa ha rindzelanga.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Ntirho lowu a wu kumiwanga wu khomiwile, hikwalaho a wu koti ku lahliwa.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Ntirho lowu wu nga tirhisiwa nakambe sweswi naswona wu ta hela hi woxe, hikwalaho a wu lahliwanga.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Nxaxamelo lowu wa fambelanisiwa sweswi. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka nkarhinyana.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Xiendlo lexi a xi kotanga ku hetiwa. Pfuxeta tluka kutani u ringeta nakambe.
interrupted-import-heading: Ku nghenisa ka tibodo loku yimeke ku nga si hela
interrupted-import-description: Ku nghenisa kun'wana na kun'wana ka tibodo leti ku yimile exikarhi - sevha yi sungurile nakambe, kumbe ku nghenisa ku tsandzekile - naswona ku siyile bodo ya xiphemu. Ku nghenisa a ku koti ku yisiwa emahlweni, hikuva fayili ya xona ya xihlovo a yi hlayisiwi. Hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona, kumbe u yi lahla u nghenisa fayili nakambe. Ku lahla ku susa bodo leyi ku nghenisa loku ku yi endleke na hinkwaswo leswi nga eka yona, ku katsa na xin'wana na xin'wana lexi engeteriweke eka yona ku sukela kwalaho.
interrupted-import-state-stopped: Swi yimile swi nga si hela, eka __stage__
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Swa lahliwa; lahla nakambe ku hetisa
interrupted-import-scrum: Xiyimo xa yona xa Scrum xi ni ndhawu ya xona yo kambela (__state__, __next__ ka __total__ ka magoza). Loko u hlayisa bodo, yi hetise kumbe u yi lahla eka ku vuyisela ka ku nghenisa ka Scrum ka bodo.
interrupted-import-counts: tindlela ta __swimlanes__, minxaxamelo ya __lists__, makhadi ya __cards__, minxaxamelo yo kambela ya __checklists__, mimbulavulo ya __comments__, swihlanganisi swa __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Hlayisa bodo leyi ya xiphemu hilaha yi nga hakona? A ku na lexi susiwaka, naswona ku nghenisa a ku ha kombisiwi laha.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Lahla ku nghenisa loku? Bodo leyi ku yi endleke na hinkwaswo leswi nga eka yona swi susiwa hi masiku hinkwawo.
interrupted-import-empty: Ku hava ku nghenisa ka tibodo loku kavanyetiweke loku rindzeleke ku kambisisiwa.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ku kombisiwa ya 50 ya khale ngopfu ntsena. Hlayisa kumbe u lahla yin'wana u pfuxeta ku vona yin'wana.
interrupted-import-unavailable: A swi kotekanga ku layicha ku nghenisa ka tibodo loku kavanyetiweke. Pfuxeta u ringeta nakambe.
interrupted-import-missing: Ku nghenisa loku a ka ha tsariwanga.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: Ku nghenisa loku a ka ha rindzeli xiboho.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Bodo leyi nga ni id leyi a yi endliwanga hi ku nghenisa loku, hikwalaho a yi khumbiwanga.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Xiyimo xa yona xa Scrum xa ha tsariwa kumbe ku vuyiseriwa. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku ka timinete ti nga ri tingani.
interrupted-import-failed: Xiendlo lexi a xi kotanga ku hetiwa. Pfuxeta tluka kutani u ringeta nakambe.
saml-login-not-started: Ku nghena loku hi SAML a ku sunguriwanga eka thebhu leyi ya burawuza. Hi kombela u nghena nakambe.
history-request-pending-undo: Seva a yi si tiyisisa ku tlherisela endzhaku ku cinca ka wena ko hetelela.
history-request-pending-redo: Seva a yi si tiyisisa ku tlhela u endla ku cinca ka wena ko hetelela.
history-request-hint: Ku ringeta nakambe ku phindha xikombelo lexi fanaka, kutani a swi nge pfuki swi tlherisele endzhaku ku cinca ka vumbirhi.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Ku tlherisela endzhaku, ku endla nakambe kumbe ku vuyisela ku cinca ka Scrum ku yimile hikwalaho ka ku kanetana. Ku lulamisa ka Scrum eka bodo leyi ku siviwile ku kondza swi tlhantlhiwa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: __applied__ ka __total__ ka ku cinca ku tsariwile, __pending__ a ku tsariwanga, naswona __conflicted__ ku cinciwile hi un'wana ku sukela kwalaho.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Ku tlherisela endzhaku ku vuyisa rhekhodo yin'wana na yin'wana leyi cinciweke hilaha a yi ri hakona khale; swi nyikiwa ntsena loko ku ri hava un'wana loyi a cinceke tirhekhodo toleto ku sukela kwalaho. Ku hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona ku susa ntirho lowu yimeke naswona a ku cinci tirhekhodo. Hi ndlela yihi na yihi, swi tsariwa eka Phanele ya valawuri, Swiphiqo, Ku Vuyisela.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard: Hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Hlayisa rhekhodo yin'wana na yin'wana hilaha yi nga hakona sweswi, ku katsa na ku cinca loku ntirho lowu yimeke se wu ku tsaleke?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Mulawuri wa bodo a nga yi tlherisela endzhaku kumbe a hlayisa bodo hilaha yi nga hakona.
header-login: Ku nghena hi tinhlokomhaka ta HTTP
login-setting-clear-secret: Susa nkoka lowu hlayisiweke eka phanele ya valawuri
login-setting-after-restart: Swi sungula ku tirha endzhaku ka loko WeKan yi sunguriwile nakambe
login-setting-env-only: Ntsena mbangu wa sevha wu veka leswi. Swi kombisiwa laha swo hlaya ntsena.
