email-to-card-webhook: URL ya webhook leyi nghenaka ya muphakeli wa imeyili (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark kumbe MIME relay yo ka yi nga lulamisiwanga)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Swi hlayisiwile - siya swi nga ri na nchumu ku swi hlayisa
email-to-card-clear-secret: Susa xihundla xa webhook lexi hlayisiweke
email-to-card-imap-accounts: Mabokisi ya imeyili ya IMAP yo hlaya
email-to-card-add-imap: Engetela bokisi ra imeyili ra IMAP
email-to-card-sandstorm-address: Adirese ya imeyili ya grain leyi
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Bodo leyi imeyili leyi yaka eka grain leyi yi yaka eka yona
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: A ku na - ti imeyili ntsena leti nga na thokeni ya bodo eka nhlokomhaka
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Veka leswi eka nhlokomhaka ku fikelela bodo leyi tanihi wena:
email-to-card-part-strip-quoted: Siya marungula ya khale lama tshahiweke
email-to-card-part-sender-line: Layini ya murhumeri ehenhla ka nhlamuselo
email-to-card-your-address: Adirese ya wena ya imeyili ya bodo leyi
email-to-card-address-private: Yi hlayise yi ri xihundla: un'wana na un'wana loyi a nga na yona a nga engetela tikhadi tanihi wena.
email-to-card-new-address: Adirese leyintshwa (ya khale yi ta tshika ku tirha)
email-to-card-member-enabled: Tiadirese ta mina ta bodo ta tirha
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Ku amukela imeyili a ku si lulamisiwa eka Phanele ya valawuri.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Mulawuri wa bodo a nga si pfula imeyili eka bodo leyi.
email-to-card-off-member-off: U time tiadirese ta wena ta bodo eka Swipimelo swa Xirho.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain a yi si va na adirese ya yona ya imeyili. Layicha tluka nakambe.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: U lava mpfumelelo wo tsala eka bodo leyi.
inbound-domain-invalid: Leri a hi vito ra domeni leri faneleke.
inbound-domain-required: Nyika domeni ya tiadirese ta bodo.
inbound-account-invalid: Bokisi ra imeyili ra IMAP ri lava vito ra sevha leri faneleke.
feature-views-email-desc: Bodo tanihi bokisi ra poso: nxaxamelo wa imeyili i Bokisi ra leswi nghenaka, minxaxamelo i tifolda, swikombiso i swikombiso, naswona swirho swi tsala no hlamula imeyili hi adirese ya bodo.
email-view-not-receiving: Bodo leyi a yi si amukela imeyili. Yi pfule eka Swiletelo swa Switiviso swa bodo → Imeyili ku ya eka khadi.
email-view-invalid-address: Yin'wana ya tiadirese a hi adirese ya imeyili leyi faneleke.
email-view-no-recipient: Engetela muamukeri un'we hi xiyimo xa le hansi.
email-view-too-many: Ku rhumeriwe tiimeyili to tala ngopfu eka awara leyi hundzeke. Ringeta nakambe endzhaku.
email-view-no-list: Bodo yi lava nxaxamelo wa imeyili.
feature-views-chat-desc: Bodo tanihi ndhawu ya ntirho ya mbulavurisano: tindhawu ta ntirho, tibodo, tindlela, minxaxamelo na tikhadi tanihi murhi wa tichanele, khadi exikarhi na mimbulavulo ya rona tanihi mahungu ya mbulavurisano.
chat-view-message-cards: Kombisa ntsena tikhadi leti nga na mahungu
chat-view-pick-card: Hlawula khadi eka tichanele ku ri vona laha.
chat-view-no-messages: A ku si va na mahungu. Tsala ro sungula.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Tikhadi leti fanaka eka mintlawa yo hlayanyana ya tikholomu leyi nga na mavito - hi ku hetiwa, nkoka, xiyimo kumbe xin'wana - leti fambisiwaka exikarhi ka tikholomu hi ku koka.
feature-rule-suggestions-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Milawu yi ringanyeta milawu ku suka eka leswi vanhu va swi endlaka hi voko nkarhi na nkarhi.
feature-board-summary-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Nkomiso wu kombisa leswi un'wana na un'wana a swi endleke eka bodo hi siku kumbe vhiki ro hetelela, na leswi swi hundzeriweke hi nkarhi.
feature-since-last-visit: Ku sukela eka ku endzela ka wena ko hetelela
feature-since-last-visit-desc: Menyu ya bodo → Ku sukela eka ku endzela ka wena ko hetelela ku kombisa leswi van'wana va swi cinceke eka bodo.
feature-search-phrases-desc: Ku lava hinkwako ku twisisa swiga swo fana na "tikhadi ta mina leti hundzeriweke hi nkarhi".
column-sets-empty: A ku si va na mintlawa ya tikholomu. Mulawuri wa bodo a nga endla wun'we: wu thya vito, kutani u engetela tikholomu ta wona.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Bodo tanihi xilandzeleri xa mintlhontlho xa GitHub kumbe Gitea: makhadi tanihi mintlhontlho, swikombiso ni swiyimo swa nkoka, mimbulavulo tanihi mbulavulo, swihlanganisi tanihi tifayela, ni matimu ya bodo ni ku tlherisela.
vcs-sort-comments-desc: Leswi nga ni mimbulavulo yo tala
vcs-no-issues: Ku hava xitlhontlho lexi fambelanaka ni ku lavisisa loku.
vcs-no-milestones: Ku hava swiyimo swa nkoka ka ha ri. Xikombiso lexi nga ni siku ro hetelela i xiyimo xa nkoka.
vcs-no-labels: Ku hava swikombiso ka ha ri.
vcs-no-files: Ku hava tifayela ka ha ri.
vcs-no-list: Bodo leyi a yi na nxaxamelo kumbe ndlela ya xitlhontlho.
card-qr-code-desc: Yi skena ku pfula khadi leri eka foni kumbe thebulete.
card-qr-code-too-long: Linki ya khadi leri yi lehile ngopfu eka khodi ya QR.
vcs-no-releases: A ku si va na swihangalasiwa.
vcs-no-wiki: A ku si va na wiki. Ku nghenisa nhlangano wa GitHub swi tisa wiki ya vuhlayiselo bya khodi laha.
github-org-import-desc: Vuhlayiselo byin'wana na byin'wana bya khodi bya nhlangano kumbe bya mutirhisi byi va bodo ya byona, leyi pfuriweke eka Board View / Version Control: mintlhontlho ya byona ni mimbulavulo, swikombiso ni tifayela, swihangalasiwa swa byona, maendlelo ya ntirho ya GitHub Actions tanihi milawu, ni wiki ya byona.
github-org-import-token-hint: Yi lavekaka eka vuhlayiselo bya xihundla ni ndzilakano wa API wa le henhla. Yi tirhisiwa ntsena loko ku nghenisa ku ri karhi ku famba naswona a yi hlayisiwi nikatsongo.
github-org-import-issues: Mintlhontlho, ni mimbulavulo, swikombiso ni tifayela
github-org-import-release-files: Tifayela ta swihangalasiwa (ti nga va letikulu)
github-org-import-actions: Maendlelo ya ntirho ya GitHub Actions tanihi milawu
github-org-import-result: Mintlhontlho ya %s, swihangalasiwa swa %s, milawu ya %s, matluka ya wiki ya %s
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Tsala vito ra nhlangano kumbe ra mutirhisi, kumbe adirese ya rona ya GitHub.
github-org-import-no-repos: A ku na vuhlayiselo byo nghenisa.
github-org-import-running: Ku nghenisa ka nhlangano se ku le ku fambeni.
optional-apis-desc: Ti-REST API leti nga ni xivumbeko xa ti-API ta swilandzeleri swin'wana, leswaku tiapp ni tiscript ta swona ti kota ku tirhisa WeKan leyi tanihi xisekelo xa tona: leswi ti swi hlayisaka swi hlayisiwa eka WeKan, eka tibodo ta WeKan. Yin'wana ni yin'wana yi timiwile ku fikela loko yi hlawuriwa laha. A ku na yin'wana leyi nga ni timfanelo ta yona: khasimende ri nghena hi token ya API ya WeKan naswona ri nga vona ni ku cinca ntsena leswi munhu yoloye a nga swi vonaka ni ku swi cinca eka WeKan. Hinkwato ti lava leswaku REST API ya WeKan yi pfuriwa (WITH_API=true). Adirese leyi nga ehansi ka yin'wana ni yin'wana hi yona leyi khasimende ri yi tirhisaka tanihi xiphakelo xa rona.
optional-api-trello-desc: Tiapp ni tiscript leti tsaleriweke REST API ya Trello (xikombiso Trellinator) ti tirha ni WeKan: tibodo, minxaxamelo, tikhadi, swikombiso, swirho, mimbulavulo ni minxaxamelo yo kambela. Token ya Trello i token ya API ya WeKan. Ku susa khadi swi ri yisa eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale eka WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Makhasimende ya REST API v2 ya Jira ma tirha ni WeKan: phurojeke i bodo (khiya ra yona i khiya ra bodo), xitlhontlho i khadi (DEV-7), xiyimo i nxaxamelo, naswona ku hundza swi fambisa khadi. Ku lavisisa ku amukela JQL yo olova: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text na ORDER BY. Nghena hi token ya API ya WeKan tanihi xiletelo xa xihundla. Ku susa xitlhontlho swi xi yisa eka vuhlayiselo bya swa khale.
optional-api-github-desc: Makhasimende ya REST API ya GitHub ya mintlhontlho ma tirha ni WeKan: vuhlayiselo bya khodi i bodo, xitlhontlho i khadi, swin'we ni swikombiso, swiyimo swa nkoka (swikombiso leswi nga ni siku ro hetelela), mimbulavulo, ni ku pfuriwa kumbe ku pfariwa ku fana na le ka Xivoni xa bodo / Ku lawula vuhundzuluxi. Token i token ya API ya WeKan.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Makhasimende ya REST API ya Gitea na Forgejo ya mintlhontlho ma tirha ni WeKan, hi ndlela leyi fanaka ni API leyi faneleke GitHub: vuhlayiselo bya khodi i bodo naswona xitlhontlho i khadi. Token i token ya API ya WeKan.
bots-none: A ku na tibhoti ha yena. Bhoti i xitirhisi lexi tirhaka eka sevha ya wena - muyimeri wa AI, ntirho wa CI, xikiripti - lexi bodo leyi yi xi nyikaka tikhadi.
bots-no-runs: A ku na bhoti leyi tirhaka sweswi.
bot-not-found: Bhoti yoleyo a yi kona eka bodo leyi.
bot-option-not-found: Nhlamulo yoleyo a hi yin'wana ya leti bhoti yi ti nyikeke.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Ti-webhook leti humaka a ti pfumeleriwi ku fika eka tiadirese ta netiweke ya WeKan hi yoxe, leswaku ku nga vi na munhu loyi a nga kongomisaka webhook ya bodo eka vukorhokeri bya le ndzeni. Tsala laha ti-host ta netiweke yoleyo leti ti-webhook ti pfumeleriwaka ku fika eka tona - Node-RED, server ya ku bula - yin'we eka layini yin'wana na yin'wana, tanihi vito kumbe adirese, na port ku pfumelela port yoleyo ntsena. Swi pfumala nchumu: a ku na. I valawuri va sayiti ntsena lava nga cincaka nxaxamelo lowu.
account-webhook: Webhook yo nghena ni ku tsarisa
account-webhook-desc: Adirese yin'we leyi WeKan yi yi tivisaka loko munhu a nghena kumbe ku endliwa akhawunti leyintshwa. A ku na nchumu lowu rhumeriwaka ku fikela loko xiendlakalo xin'wana laha hansi xi hlawuriwile. Yi rhwala xiendlakalo, vito ra mutirhisi ni nkarhi; hlawula swivandla swin'wana loko muamukeri a swi lava ntsena.
account-webhook-field-ip: Adirese ya IP leyi ku nghena ku humeke eka yona
webhook-internal-hosts-rejected: A hi host, a swi hlayisiwanga:
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Khansela swituxiso hinkwaswo swa migingiriko leswi ha swi rindzeleke, leswi swi hundzeke masiku mangani?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Ku khanseriwile %s, ku rhumeriwile %s, %s swa khale swa ha rindzerile.
vcs-synced-from: Swi fambanisiwile ku suka eka %s: xi pfula u xi pfala kwalaho.
vcs-synced-issue: Xitlhontlho lexi xi fambanisiwile: xi pfula u xi pfala eka xilandzeleri xa xona.
sync-write-back: Tsala ku cinca ku tlhelela eka GitLab: nhloko-mhaka, nhlamuselo, mimbulavulo, ku pfala na ku pfula nakambe
sync-write-back-error: Ku tsala ku tlhelela eka GitLab ku tsandzekile
email-bounces-description: Leswi WeKan yi swi endlaka hi imeyili leyi vuyaka: adirese leyi tsariweke hi xihoxo, bokisi ra poso leri teleke, nhlamulo ya leswaku a ndzi kona ehofisini, xivilelo xa spam. Muxaka wun'wana na wun'wana wu na swiendlo swa wona, leswi endliwaka loko wu vuyile minkarhi yo tano.
email-bounces-enabled: Lawula ti-imeyili leti vuyeke eka WeKan
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Tshika ku rhumela imeyili eka adirese
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Adirese a yi kona: xihoxo xa ku tsala, akhawunti leyi susiweke, domeyini leyi nga tiviwiki.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: A yi si fikisiwa sweswi: bokisi ri tele, sevha yi khomekile. Leti talaka ti landzelelana ntsena ti na nhlamuselo.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Tinhlamulo ta ku nga vi kona ehofisini, ta holideyi kumbe ta sisiteme ya tithikiti. Imeyili yi fikisiwile.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Muamukeri u fungile imeyili tanihi spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: Eka Amazon SES, rhumela switiviso swa Bounce na Complaint, na nawu wa ku amukela wa adirese leyi WeKan yi rhumelaka ha yona, eka nhloko-mhaka ya SNS, kutani u tsarisa adirese leyi eka yona hi HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: Ti-ARN ta tinhloko-mhaka ta SNS leti amukeriwaka, yin'we hi layini
email-bounces-stopped-only: Tiadirese ntsena leti WeKan yi nga ha ti rhumeleriki imeyili
email-bounces-clear-hint: Rivala ku vuya ka adirese leyi kutani u yi rhumelela imeyili nakambe
email-bounce-invalid-topic: Leswi a hi ARN ya nhloko-mhaka ya SNS.
email-bounces-providers-description: Loko WeKan yi rhumela hi vun'wana bya vukorhokeri lebyi, byi lumeke, nyika vukorhokeri adirese leyi ya webhook ya swiendlakalo swa byona swa ti-imeyili leti vuyeke ni swivilelo swa spam, kutani u namarheta laha xikhiya lexi byi swi sayinaka ha xona, kumbe xiletelo xa xihundla lexi u xi vekeke eka adirese tanihi https://user:password@… kumbe ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Vukorhokeri lebyi lumekiweke byi lava xikhiya xa byona xo sayina kumbe xiletelo xa xihundla.
activity-pub-enabled: Tibodo ta vanhu hinkwavo ti humesa mintirho ya tikhadi ta tona eka fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Ri timiwile hi ndlela ya ntolovelo. Loko ri vulekile, bodo yin'wana na yin'wana ya vanhu hinkwavo yi nga landzeriwa ku suka eka Mastodon na tisevha tin'wana ta fediverse tanihi @board-<id> eka adirese ya WeKan leyi, naswona ntirho lowuntshwa wa tikhadi wu fika eka valandzeri va yona. I ku hlaya ntsena: a ku na nchumu lowu rhumeriwaka hi sevha ya fediverse lowu cincaka bodo, naswona tibodo ta xihundla a ti humesiwi nikatsongo.
caldav-sync-desc: Yi veka masiku yo hetelela ya tikhadi ta bodo leyi eka khalendara - Nextcloud Calendar kumbe khalendara yin'wana ya CalDAV. Siku ro hetelela leri susiweke eka khalendara ri vuyela eka khadi. Tirhisa xiletelo xa xihundla xa app, ku nga ri xa wena.
caldav-enabled: Fambelanisa masiku yo hetelela na khalendara leyi
caldav-invalid-url: Adirese ya khalendara yi fanele ku va adirese ya http:// kumbe https://, handle ka vito ra mutirhisi kumbe xiletelo xa xihundla eka yona.
caldav-not-linked: Hlayisa adirese ya khalendara ku sungula ivi u pfula ku fambelanisa.
webdav-storage-description: Yi hlayisa swihlanganisi eka folidara eka sevha ya WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud kumbe yin'wana. Tirhisa xiletelo xa xihundla xa app lexi endleriweke WeKan. Sevha leyi nga eka netiweke ya WeKan hi yoxe yi nga tirhisiwa laha, hikuva i mulawuri wa saiti ntsena loyi a vekaka adirese leyi.
sqrl-desc: Yi timiwile hi ndlela ya ntolovelo. Loko yi pfuriwile, pheji ya ku nghena yi nyika SQRL, naswona swirho swi rhanga swi engetela vutivikelo bya swona bya SQRL eka Swiyimiso swa Xirho. SQRL yi lava leswaku WeKan yi va eka adirese ya https://.
sqrl-scan: Skena khodi hi app ya wena ya SQRL, kumbe u pfula khiliyente ya wena ya SQRL eka xitirhisiwa lexi.
sqrl-expired: Khodi leyi ya SQRL yi hundzile nkarhi wa yona. Sungula nakambe.
sqrl-sign-in-failed: Ku nghena hi SQRL ku tsandzekile.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL yi lava leswaku WeKan yi va eka adirese ya https://.
sqrl-description: Nghena hi vutivikelo bya wena bya SQRL ematshan'wini ya xiletelo xa xihundla. Byi engetele laha kan'we hi khiliyente ya wena ya SQRL; u nga byi susa laha nkarhi wun'wana ni wun'wana.
sqrl-add: Engetela vutivikelo bya mina bya SQRL
sqrl-added: Vutivikelo bya wena bya SQRL byi engeteriwile.
sqrl-none: A ku na vutivikelo bya SQRL lebyi engeteriweke.
sqrl-remove: Susa vutivikelo bya mina bya SQRL
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Ku nghena hi SQRL ku timiwile eka akhawunti leyi ku suka eka khiliyente ya wena ya SQRL. Ku pfula nakambe kona hi khodi ya wena ya ku ponisa.
sqrl-only-on: Khiliyente ya wena ya SQRL yi pfale akhawunti leyi eka SQRL ntsena: tindlela hinkwato tin'wana ta ku nghena ta aleriwa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Khiliyente ya wena ya SQRL yi pfale akhawunti leyi hi ku tiya: ku vekela xiletelo xa xihundla nakambe ni ku cinca imeyili swa aleriwa.
sqrl-only: Akhawunti leyi yi nghena hi SQRL ntsena.
sqrl-hardlock: Akhawunti leyi yi pfaleriwile eka SQRL: a yi koti ku vuyisiwa kumbe ku cinciwa hi ndlela yin'wana.
windows-sso-failed: Ku nghena hi Windows ku tsandzekile. Akhawunti ya wena ya Windows yi nga ha va yi nga pfumeleriwi laha.
blockly-TOOLBOX_SEARCH_NO_RESULTS: A ku kumiwanga mabloko lama fambelanaka
